entries.reasoning: BlueOrchid operates hotel properties in the GCC, specifically Properties 10 and 11 in Dubai, UAE, and Property 12 in Muscat, Oman. Providing AI-based guest review analytics services for these GCC properties collides directly with the Al Noor commitment, which prohibits AtliQ and its Affiliates from providing data analytics or AI services to any hospitality business for operations in the GCC during the restricted period ending September 2029.

incomingClauses.quote: 4.1 AtliQ shall deliver a guest review analytics solution for all twelve (12) Properties listed in Annexure B, comprising: (a) automated ingestion of guest reviews from up to six (6) online sources and BlueOrchid's post-stay survey tool; (b) multilingual sentiment and aspect analysis (English, Hindi, Arabic) covering room, cleanliness, F&B, service, location and value; (c) property-level and portfolio-level dashboards in Power BI for General Managers, the Guest Experience team and senior management; (d) a weekly automated "Voice of Guest" summary for each Property; and (e) an alerting mechanism flagging recurring negative themes for the relevant Property's General Manager.
10 | BlueOrchid Dubai Business Bay | Dubai | United Arab Emirates; 11 | Orchid Residences Dubai Marina | Dubai | United Arab Emirates; 12 | BlueOrchid Muscat Qurum | Muscat | Oman
9.3 Each Party warrants that it has full power and authority to enter into this Agreement.

entries.suggestedChange: Redline Annexure B and Clause 4.1 to exclude the three GCC properties (Properties 10, 11, and 12) from the pilot scope, limiting the agreement exclusively to the nine Indian properties, or seek consent from Al Noor Hospitality Group.
entries.waiverWhy: The waiver letter dated 10 February 2026 is strictly limited to demand-forecasting services for Seaside Hotels LLC in Muscat under a specific February 2026 SOW, and explicitly excludes any other hospitality business or GCC property.
entries.impact: Collides with the Al Noor commitment restricting AI and data analytics services for GCC hotel operations, which remains active until September 2029.
